Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Enabled: Shops are raided over time according to their priority. Off: nothing is changed.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.StartDa: Days since the apocalypse when looting begins (days played plus the months since the apocalypse).
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.PeakDay: The day most people raid the shops. Looting is fastest until then and slows down after it.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.EndDay_: From this day no more buildings are raided.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighPea: High priority: Share of the looting done at the peak (percent)
How much of the looting is already done on the peak day. Defaults 57.1, 60 and 66.7 leave 60, 70 and 80 percent of the loot on day 7.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.MediumP: Medium priority: Share of the looting done at the peak (percent)
How much of the looting is already done on the peak day. Defaults 57.1, 60 and 66.7 leave 60, 70 and 80 percent of the loot on day 7.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LowPeak: Low priority: Share of the looting done at the peak (percent)
How much of the looting is already done on the peak day. Defaults 57.1, 60 and 66.7 leave 60, 70 and 80 percent of the loot on day 7.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Slowdow: How fast looting slows down after the peak. Higher: slows down sooner.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.ExactCu: Optional list of day:percent points (share of all the looting done), for example 0:0;7:44;30:67;90:89;180:94;360:100. Replaces the formula. none: use the formula.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Initial: Part of all the looting already done on the start day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighCha: Share of markets, pharmacies and food shops raided by the end day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighCut: How much of its loot a raided high priority building loses.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.MediumC: Share of hardware, gun and survival stores raided by the end day.
How much of its loot a raided medium priority building loses.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LowChan: Share of small shops raided by the end day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LowCut_: How much of its loot a raided low priority building loses.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Overrun: Hospitals, prisons, police and army buildings were too dangerous to raid and get this much extra loot. 0: normal loot.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighRoo: Room names, separated by semicolons. Add rooms from other maps or mods here.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Overrun: Room names, separated by semicolons. Never raided, and they get the extra loot.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.CutVari: Each raided building cuts a random amount around the set cut, so raided shops do not all look the same. The average stays the same.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Strippe: Share of raided buildings that are emptied completely.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.UsefulF: Raided buildings lose food, medicine, tools and weapons before clothes and junk, with the same total cut.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.CountVa: Count buildings the game already looted
The game can already loot buildings by itself (Maximum Looted Building Chance). On: those count toward the share, so the total follows the curve. Off: both add up.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LateCut: Also apply to containers already filled
A shop you saw earlier but never opened can still have been raided when you first open a container in it. Off: only the moment an area first loads counts.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Passing: Days until a looted-and-left building can be raided
A building where you only looted or passed through is left alone for this many days after your last activity there.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.BaseDay: Days until a base counts as abandoned
A building you use as a base is left alone for this many days after your last activity there.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.BaseIte: Items stored to count as a base
Storing this many items in a building makes it a base.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.BaseAct: Days of activity to count as a base
Using a building on this many different days makes it a base.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.CutAban: Cut the leftovers of abandoned buildings
When a building you used has been abandoned long enough, other survivors take part of what is left. Items you stored are never removed.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.ApplyOn: Apply when vanilla loot respawn refills a container
If the game refills containers (Loot Respawn), the refill follows the building decision too.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LogDeci: Writes every building decision to the console, for testing.
